k: She has been spinning in the Whisperwold's heart since before the Mother. The web catches birds, deer and, once, a tax collector.
src: 'She has been spinning in the Whisperwold\'s heart since before the Mother. The web catches birds, deer and, once, a tax collector.'

k: A rat king: a hundred rats bound tail to tail, sharing one hunger. When it is hurt it eats a few of its own and grows back.
src: 'A rat king: a hundred rats bound tail to tail, sharing one hunger. When it is hurt it eats a few of its own and grows back.'

k: A sun-basilisk of the Sunscar. Its glass eye holds the noon, and anyone who meets its gaze stands very still.
src: 'A sun-basilisk of the Sunscar. Its glass eye holds the noon, and anyone who meets its gaze stands very still.'

k: Grandfather of every toad in the Mirefen, by his own account. Sings to the marsh at dusk, and the marsh goes to sleep.
src: 'Grandfather of every toad in the Mirefen, by his own account. Sings to the marsh at dusk, and the marsh goes to sleep.'

k: It swims through the Drift's ash as a pike swims through a pond. Where it surfaces, the ash remembers it was once fire.
src: 'It swims through the Drift\'s ash as a pike swims through a pond. Where it surfaces, the ash remembers it was once fire.'

k: It lived under the Drowned Choir for a hundred years, listening. When the singers drowned, it took up the hymns.
src: 'It lived under the Drowned Choir for a hundred years, listening. When the singers drowned, it took up the hymns.'

k: Every engine that fell into the Boneyard went into it. It crowned itself with the rivets. It has never stopped building.
src: 'Every engine that fell into the Boneyard went into it. It crowned itself with the rivets. It has never stopped building.'

k: The pass's oldest story. She sings travelers to sleep in the snow, the monks say, and her wolves come for them after.
src: 'The pass\'s oldest story. She sings travelers to sleep in the snow, the monks say, and her wolves come for them after.'

k: An eye at the bottom of the Rift that has never once closed. It has been very tired for a very long time, and it wants company.
src: 'An eye at the bottom of the Rift that has never once closed. It has been very tired for a very long time, and it wants company.'

k: Widowling
src: 'Widowling'

k: One of the Widow's brood. She has hundreds. Mostly they are hungry.
src: 'One of the Widow\'s brood. She has hundreds. Mostly they are hungry.'

k: Old Gnarlhide's hackles rise. He paws the earth.
src: 'Old Gnarlhide\'s hackles rise. He paws the earth.'

k: Old Gnarlhide lowers his tusks and scrapes the ground...
src: 'Old Gnarlhide lowers his tusks and scrapes the ground...'

k: The Widow throws a shroud of silk over everything.
src: 'The Widow throws a shroud of silk over everything.'

k: The web shivers. More of the brood come down it.
src: 'The web shivers. More of the brood come down it.'

k: Mother Knot pulls one of its own rats into itself...
src: 'Mother Knot pulls one of its own rats into itself...'

k: A hundred voices squeal. Rats boil up out of the drains.
src: 'A hundred voices squeal. Rats boil up out of the drains.'

k: Glasseye's skin cracks and peels away. Fresh glass gleams underneath.
src: 'Glasseye\'s skin cracks and peels away. Fresh glass gleams underneath.'

k: The sun in Glasseye's eye flares white...
src: 'The sun in Glasseye\'s eye flares white...'

k: Old Belcher's throat swells like a bellows...
src: 'Old Belcher\'s throat swells like a bellows...'

k: Old Belcher croaks. The bog croaks back.
src: 'Old Belcher croaks. The bog croaks back.'

k: Cinderjaw's scales split open, and fire pours out of the cracks.
src: 'Cinderjaw\'s scales split open, and fire pours out of the cracks.'

k: Cinderjaw thrashes. Burning motes spin up out of the ash.
src: 'Cinderjaw thrashes. Burning motes spin up out of the ash.'

k: Cinderjaw dives under the ash. The ground grows hot...
src: 'Cinderjaw dives under the ash. The ground grows hot...'

k: Hymnal takes a deep breath and holds it, like a singer before the last verse...
src: 'Hymnal takes a deep breath and holds it, like a singer before the last verse...'

k: The Scrap King tears a drone apart and bolts the pieces into himself.
src: 'The Scrap King tears a drone apart and bolts the pieces into himself.'

k: The Scrap King hammers a new drone together out of nothing.
src: 'The Scrap King hammers a new drone together out of nothing.'

k: The Scrap King raises both fists over his crown...
src: 'The Scrap King raises both fists over his crown...'

k: Grandmother Frost begins to hum a lullaby...
src: 'Grandmother Frost begins to hum a lullaby...'

k: "Come, children. Supper."
src: '"Come, children. Supper."'

k: Neverwake looks at you. Your eyelids grow heavy...
src: 'Neverwake looks at you. Your eyelids grow heavy...'

k: The dark in the Rift draws in toward the eye...
src: 'The dark in the Rift draws in toward the eye...'

k: Hunt
src: 'Hunt'

k: Greer Thackery
src: 'Greer Thackery'

k: The Hunter's Ledger
src: 'The Hunter\'s Ledger'

k: The Drowned Cantor
src: 'The Drowned Cantor'

k: A Tidecaller who sang the boats home for forty years, and went down with the last one. She still keeps the crest-glass. She still sings.
src: 'A Tidecaller who sang the boats home for forty years, and went down with the last one. She still keeps the crest-glass. She still sings.'

k: The Bronze Abbot
src: 'The Bronze Abbot'

k: The bell the founders were made to melt down, poured instead into a guardian and walled up with their calling. It has been waiting to be rung.
src: 'The bell the founders were made to melt down, poured instead into a guardian and walled up with their calling. It has been waiting to be rung.'

k: The Scrap Colossus
src: 'The Scrap Colossus'

k: The first Kitewrights built it to lift their workshop into the sky. It never flew. It has guarded what they left ever since, out of loyalty or spite.
src: 'The first Kitewrights built it to lift their workshop into the sky. It never flew. It has guarded what they left ever since, out of loyalty or spite.'

k: The Forgetting
src: 'The Forgetting'

k: What the Choir set to guard the last Mnemonist's grave: an appetite for memory. It eats names first.
src: 'What the Choir set to guard the last Mnemonist\'s grave: an appetite for memory. It eats names first.'

k: The Drowned Cantor's hymn breaks over you like a wave!
src: 'The Drowned Cantor\'s hymn breaks over you like a wave!'

k: She hums the song mothers sang on the docks. Your eyes grow heavy...
src: 'She hums the song mothers sang on the docks. Your eyes grow heavy...'

k: The Drowned Cantor draws a breath that sounds like the tide going out... Guard!
src: 'The Drowned Cantor draws a breath that sounds like the tide going out... Guard!'

k: BONG. The floor of the foundry jumps.
src: 'BONG. The floor of the foundry jumps.'

k: The Abbot's bronze rings, and goes still and hard.
src: 'The Abbot\'s bronze rings, and goes still and hard.'

k: The Bronze Abbot swings back, back, back on its yoke... Guard!
src: 'The Bronze Abbot swings back, back, back on its yoke... Guard!'

k: The Colossus vents its whole boiler over you!
src: 'The Colossus vents its whole boiler over you!'

k: Plates fall away. What is left of it moves faster.
src: 'Plates fall away. What is left of it moves faster.'

k: The Scrap Colossus whines higher and higher, steam screaming from every seam... Guard!
src: 'The Scrap Colossus whines higher and higher, steam screaming from every seam... Guard!'

k: The Forgetting opens, and every name you know goes quiet for a moment.
src: 'The Forgetting opens, and every name you know goes quiet for a moment.'

k: Somewhere a clock forgets how to tick.
src: 'Somewhere a clock forgets how to tick.'

k: The Forgetting turns toward you, and you cannot remember why you came... Guard!
src: 'The Forgetting turns toward you, and you cannot remember why you came... Guard!'

k: Blue Envelope
src: 'Blue Envelope'

k: Water-stained, still sealed. "To Da, from Mara." It landed on the third stair of the Abyss.
src: 'Water-stained, still sealed. "To Da, from Mara." It landed on the third stair of the Abyss.'

k: An eighth Lantern on the lip of the deepest rift, shining down. Thirty stairs below, something without edges sleeps.
src: 'An eighth Lantern on the lip of the deepest rift, shining down. Thirty stairs below, something without edges sleeps.'

src: 'Taking Aim...'

k: Not a hound. The rumor of one — the feeling of being followed home, given teeth.
src: 'Not a hound. The rumor of one — the feeling of being followed home, given teeth.'

k: Murk Ooze
src: 'Murk Ooze'

k: Every spilled thought pools somewhere. Down here, it pools into this.
src: 'Every spilled thought pools somewhere. Down here, it pools into this.'

k: Memories nobody kept. They whisper names at you, hoping one of them is theirs.
src: 'Memories nobody kept. They whisper names at you, hoping one of them is theirs.'

k: Gloammoth
src: 'Gloammoth'

k: Drawn to light. There is no light down here, so it is drawn to you.
src: 'Drawn to light. There is no light down here, so it is drawn to you.'

k: Dreadhound
src: 'Dreadhound'

k: The Umbral Hound, after it caught up with someone.
src: 'The Umbral Hound, after it caught up with someone.'

k: Nightmare Weave
src: 'Nightmare Weave'

k: Every bad dream ever woken from, knotted together. It wants to finish them.
src: 'Every bad dream ever woken from, knotted together. It wants to finish them.'

k: Eye of Below
src: 'Eye of Below'

k: It has been looking up for a long time, waiting for something to fall.
src: 'It has been looking up for a long time, waiting for something to fall.'

src: 'Gloamcrystal Golem'
